events.title: Big Mic (stand-up comedy)
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best open mic comedy! Featuring the best and brightest up and coming comedians from Brisbane and beyond, plus you never know who might drop in. Cold drinks and a relaxed vibe - you'll be howling with laughter. TICKETS ARE ONLY $10 ONLINE | $15 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Cage Match: Improv Comedy Showdown PLUS Musical Comedy
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Every Thursday, the best indie improv teams face off against each other in the ultimate comedy showdown - Cage Match!!! Each week, the reigning Cage Match champions are challenged by a new team. Both teams get 15 minutes to wow the audience, who pick the winner. This is high octane laugh out loud improv comedy. Opening the show this week is the Musical Mixer - musical improv comedy show featuring Brisbane's best musical improvisers. Featuring Brisbane's best improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $10 ONLINE | $15 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Brisbane's Best Newest Improviser Heat 2 (improv comedy competition)
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! We are on the hunt to crown Brisbane’s Best Newest Improviser. Special prizes and glory awaits the improviser that can make it through the Heats unscathed and come out on top in the Grand Final. This competition will have it all: improv games, hilarious scenes and challenges, musical comedy, special guests, expert judges, and you cheering for your favourite improviser. Grab your tickets and come support Brisbane’s Best Newest Improviser. This will be fun! Heat 1 – Friday 18 September 7pm Heat 2 – Friday 25 September 7pm Heat 3 – Sunday 27 September 7pm Heat 4 – Friday 2 October 7pm Grand Final – Friday 9 October 7pm Featuring Brisbane’s best newest improvisers. If you are interested in competing in Brisbane's Best Newest Improviser, please contact chris@bigforktheatre.com TICKETS ARE ONLY $20 ONLINE | $25 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Saturday Night Comedy: Big Fork's Big Fun Showcase
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Featuring some of Brisbane’s funniest comedians, Big Fork’s Big Fun Showcase is exactly what make’s Big Fork Theatre Brisbane’s home of improv comedy! Expect a night of laughs, excitement and thrills as you sit on the edge of your seat wondering ‘was that really unscripted?’ Trust us – you couldn’t write this if you tried. In its 11th year of making audiences laugh and teaching the next generation of comedians, Big Fork Theatre is a Brisbane Institution. This Showcase shows off our purpose built theatre and what makes us one of Brisbane’s best nights out! Featuring funny scenes, musical improv, special guests and more, it’s an event not be missed. If you are a fan of Dropout TV, Who’s Line is it Anyway? or Thank God You’re Here, this is your gateway show to more hilarious nights at Big Fork Theatre, where every show is hilarious and completely unique. Featuring Brisbane's best improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $20 ONLINE | $25 ON THE DOOR

events.title: Student Graduation Show: Improv Fundamentals & Group Mind
events.location: Big Fork Theatre, 252 Saint Pauls Terrace
events.description: Brisbane's best improv comedy! Our Improv students have been working hard learning all the basics of improv comedy, and now they get to showcase these new skills in a final graduation show! There are 2 improv classes graduating today: Foundations 1: Improv Fundamentals (Ben's class) Foundations 4: Group Mind (Cameron's class) Calling on friends, family, partners, work colleagues, and anyone else - come support this new crop of students as they take their improv journey to the next level. Featuring Brisbane's newest improv comedians. TICKETS ARE ONLY $10 ONLINE | $15 ON THE DOOR
